title: 오늘 날씨 어때요? 날씨 말하기
objective: By the end, you can say in simple Korean whether it is hot, cold, clear, cloudy, rainy, snowy, or windy today.
summary: Learn ten basic Korean words for talking about the weather.

task.title: TALK ABOUT THE WEATHER
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, or write the weather word that fits.

words.exampleMeaning: The weather is really nice today.
It's cloudy. Take an umbrella with you.
It snowed a lot in Seoul yesterday.
It's very windy. Please close the window.
Is it cold today? — Yes, a little.
The weather is warm in spring.
In fall, the wind feels cool.

exercises: Choose the right word: 한국은 12월에 날씨가 (더워요 / 추워요).
Fill in the blank with the right verb: 우산이 없어요. 그런데 밖에 비가 ____.
Choose 맑아요 or 흐려요 for each: ①하늘에 해가 있어요. 오늘은 날씨가 ____. ②하늘이 어두워요. 오늘은 날씨가 ____.
Fill in each blank with 눈 or 바람: ①길이 다 하얘요. ____이 왔어요. ②모자를 잡으세요! ____이 불어요.
Choose the right word: 10월이에요. 바람이 (시원해요 / 더워요).
Answer in Korean (it is warm): 오늘 날씨가 어때요?
